name: Mezzo Pollo Academy
pitch: A plush half-chicken runs three lanes and must pass under the gate with the right half: numbers, words and mirrored shapes. When the WHOLE CHICKEN flies over, don't move.
access: Pre-launch fixture declaration: no Solana mint exists yet (intended network: Solana mainnet-beta). This build is practice-only: no wallet connection, no timelock gate, no transactions. Planned policy: any unexpired lock of the future mint in the existing DevFridge program 9RY54dNPYTzDyh3TfFqDdt2b2KMM56KW1tw9erRTGQo6, with no minimum original or remaining duration; minimum amount and aggregation still to be decided. Expired locks stop counting and failed or stale evidence never grants access. Locks would unlock cosmetics and seasonal challenges only; all educational modes stay free. No early withdrawal. Redemption fee: 2% for PASTA buy-and-burn plus network costs. Non-PASTA redemption needs an executable Jupiter route; Token-2022 compatibility and routing are unverified until launch. Wallet features intended for adults only.
limitations: Static Three.js r128 prototype, without a TypeScript/Vite build. Free practice only: no launched mint, wallet, DevFridge gate or transactions. Scores and personal bests are local and unverified; no leaderboard, rewards or multiplayer. Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12: desktop plus phone portrait/landscape emulation; 38 music checks cover gesture playback, pause/resume, mute, persistence, cue ducking, real loop and injected MP3 failure recovery. Hidden-page handling tested synthetically. Silent desktop/mobile recordings predate music integration; full soundtrack is on the demo page. No physical-phone, Phantom, screen-lock, sustained-performance or real-chain testing. Art is procedural; SFX are synthesized; Google Lyria generated the project soundtrack, with provenance documented. Three.js is MIT and Google Fonts are SIL OFL. Gallery review is not final competition eligibility.
